vetting_note: Opened the full CHM Wilkinson finding aid text via the CONTENTdm dmwebservices JSON (collections.carli.illinois.edu dmGetItemInfo chm_fa/2106, now reachable): vol. 3 p. 66 item 91, 4 May 1809, Washington, Eustis to Wilkinson, 'Routine; receipt of ciphered message; most necessary for U.S. to maintain friendly relations with neighboring colonies'. The wording is receipt of a ciphered message, whereas the next-but-one item 93 (10 May 1809, p. 67, already in the catalogue) is described 'part of message in cypher', so item 91 reads as a clear acknowledgement of a cipher message sent separately; but the calendar is all that is online and the leaf itself (CHM Research Center, vol. 3 p. 66; 1976 microfilm) has not been seen, so no ciphertext is shown and not_cipher is not proven. Two more searches (Eustis Wilkinson May 1809 cipher; Eustis Wilkinson April 1809 Folch ciphered message) found only Founders Online context and no edition. Needs the CHM microfilm or a CHM reply on whether p. 66 carries cipher groups.
